_note: Site settings. Measure the gap with: python -m qandeel.measure_gap --a 'lat, lon' --b 'lat, lon' (see README).
_latlon_note: Approximate public location of the plant; the data point used for currents is offset ~5 km offshore.
gap_depth_source: Public marine-works description of the Barakah intake channel: dredged to -5.5 to -9.5 m MSL; deepest value used (not a survey).
gap_location: Mouth of the intake channel at the end of the western breakwater, about 3 km offshore (Google Earth, Oct 2026). Tips measured by the team; depth not surveyed.
_release_note: Release only between west and north-north-east of the mouth: the cooling-water discharge lies to the east.
